blocks.text: Meadow Brook Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Cherrybrook Place, inside that boundary, is a named street in the replacement zoning schedules, with addresses such as 991, 993, 995 and 997 Cherrybrook Place listed parcel by parcel in the draft Comprehensive Development zone.
Meadowbrook Elementary, at 900 Sharpe Street, is the addressed school anchor for this side of Coquitlam, on Sharpe Street south of the Dewdney Trunk Road boundary.

blocks.text: Meadow Brook Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses held for decades under a land use contract (LUC), which is why this pocket's rules story is a zoning-replacement story rather than a standard subdivision story: the City replaced the contract zoning parcel by parcel, with Cherrybrook Place addresses listed one by one in the draft Comprehensive Development zone.
The replacement zoning is now the governing zoning for these lots, ahead of the land use contract's June 30, 2024 end date.

blocks.text: Meadow Brook Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Land Use Contract replacement rezoning was initiated December 6, 2021, with new zoning required by June 30, 2022 ahead of the June 30, 2024 contract end, so a Meadowbrook house is bought under the replacement zone, not under the old contract.

Coquitlam's small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules allow up to 3 units on lots of 280 square metres or smaller and up to 4 units on lots larger than 280 square metres and under 4,050 square metres, and the City states it currently has no bus stops meeting the provincial frequent-service criteria, so the 6-unit tier does not apply.
Coquitlam is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: Meadow Brook Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The board spells the area "Meadow Brook" and the City spells it "Meadowbrook" — the same pocket under two spellings, so City documents are found under the one-word spelling.

Cherrybrook Place's houses are individually listed in the replacement zoning schedules — 991, 993, 995 and 997 Cherrybrook Place appear parcel by parcel — which is how granular the contract replacement was.
Meadowbrook Elementary at 900 Sharpe Street sits just south of the neighbourhood boundary street, Dewdney Trunk Road, on Sharpe Street.

blocks.text: Meadow Brook Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Coquitlam property tax payment was due July 2, 2026, covering January 1 through December 31, 2026, with a 5 percent penalty on any unpaid balance after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5 percent penalty after September 15, 2026.

The Home Owner Grant reduces the provincial property taxes on a principal residence, and eligible homeowners apply directly through the Province of British Columbia before the tax due date to avoid penalty.
Coquitlam utility charges cover water, sewer and drainage and solid waste, separate from the property tax bill.
Dewdney Trunk Road is the boundary street on the north and Irvine Street the west-side street of the City's stated boundary, with Greene Street at the south.
City Hall, at 3000 Guildford Way, is where the City's annual tax sale is held, in Council Chambers on the last Monday of September.

blocks.text: Meadow Brook Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Read the replacement zone, not the old land use contract, for what a Meadowbrook lot allows, and confirm the parcel's zone schedule with the City, since addresses were rezoned parcel by parcel.
Confirm the lot's SSMUH unit count with the City before assuming added units, because the count turns on lot area and Coquitlam has no frequent-service bus stops to trigger the 6-unit tier.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Meadow Brook?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 5 houses listed in Meadow Brook. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Meadow Brook a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Meadow Brook had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Meadow Brook from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses sold in Meadow Brook over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Meadow Brook?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What is a land use contract and why does it matter here?
faq.a: Meadowbrook's houses sat under a land use contract, a legacy zoning contract the City had to replace before the contract's June 30, 2024 end: the City initiated the replacement rezoning on December 6, 2021, required new zoning by June 30, 2022, and completed the process by the provincial deadline, so buyers now check the replacement zone for what a lot allows.
Meadowbrook Elementary, at 900 Sharpe Street, is the addressed School District No.

faq.q: How many units can a Meadowbrook house lot take under the small-scale rules?
faq.a: Up to 3 units on lots of 280 square metres or smaller and up to 4 units on lots larger than 280 square metres and under 4,050 square metres, and because Coquitlam currently has no bus stops meeting the provincial frequent-service criteria, the provincial 6-unit tier near frequent transit does not apply in the city.

faq.q: When are Coquitlam property taxes due?
faq.a: Property tax payment was due July 2, 2026, covering January 1 through December 31, 2026, with a 5 percent penalty on any unpaid balance after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5 percent penalty on any unpaid balance after September 15, 2026, including unclaimed Home Owner Grants.

faq.q: What did houses in Meadow Brook sell for?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Meadow Brook between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $984,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Meadow Brook?
faq.a: The median was 41 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
